title: 8.53. Kilesasaṅkilesikaduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nakilesañceva naasaṅkilesikañca dhammaṁ paṭicca nakileso ceva naasaṅkilesiko ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Naasaṅkilesikañceva nano ca kilesaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naasaṅkilesiko ceva nano ca kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Nakilesañceva naasaṅkilesikañca naasaṅkilesikañceva nano ca kilesañca dhammaṁ paṭicca nakileso ceva naasaṅkilesiko ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
